comment: Security support of the release lines the site runs on: the Next.js major that package.json pins and the Node.js major its `engines` names (the deploy scripts install the same NODE_MAJOR). scripts/audit-check.mjs (npm run audit:check, also part of npm run check:release) fails once today is past a line's `securityUntil`, or when the pinned line has no entry here, and warns from `warnDays` before; npm audit alone never reports a line that is out of support (SITE-R5-CSP-01). Update an entry from its `source` when the vendor changes its schedule, and add the next line before upgrading to it.

lines.name: next
lines.rule: Active LTS until the next major is released, then Maintenance LTS (critical and security fixes only) until two years after the major's first release.

lines.name: node
lines.rule: The schedule's `end` date of the line.
